actions.name: Update Import Mapping
actions.description: Create or refresh the Jira Assets external import source schema and field mapping.

actions.name: Submit Data
actions.description: Submit one page of Jamf Pro data to the Jira Assets import source.

actions.name: Check Import Status
actions.description: Read the import source status so a run left RUNNING by a previous execution can be cancelled.

actions.name: Cancel Stuck Import
actions.description: Cancel the previous import when it is still running, so a stuck run does not block this one.

conditions.description: Only cancel when the previous execution is still running.

actions.name: Start Import
actions.description: Start a new import execution and obtain the submit and cancel URLs for this run.

actions.name: Complete Import
actions.description: Mark the import execution complete so Jira Assets processes the submitted data.

description: Import Jamf Pro computer inventory into Jira Assets

flowVariables.name: assetSchema
flowVariables.instruction: Name of the target object schema in Jira Assets.

flowVariables.name: importSourceId
flowVariables.instruction: Jira Assets external import source ID. Replace with the customer's own ID, or leave as-is on a fresh install to have one created.

flowVariables.name: JAMF_URL
flowVariables.instruction: Jamf Pro base URL, without a trailing slash.
